newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Rouse Singapore offers price service on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Rouse Singapore offers price service on Internet.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Rouse Derivates in Singapore plans to offer an Internet service for price enquiries on oil and commodity swaps.
The company said in a statement it was the first international bank to offer the service, which allows customers to ask for market prices covering swaps across the board for oil and commodities.
Singapore will be the first of Rouse's offices worldwide to test the service, mostly aimed at smaller customers, although deals would initially continue to be done by telephone.
Rouse is a unit of Credit Lyonnais of France.
